booking.question: How do I change or cancel a booking?
booking.answer: Open My account ? Bookings, select your stay and use the available actions (pay, cancel). If an option is missing, contact us with your booking reference.

payment.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
payment.answer: Secure online card payments (Stripe) are offered at checkout. Charges and invoices depend on the property and product booked.

cancellation.question: What is your cancellation policy?
cancellation.answer: Terms vary by property or provider. Check the product page and your confirmation email. If unsure, open a ticket with your booking reference.

account.question: How do I update my profile or addresses?
account.answer: From My account, use Profile and Addresses. You can change display language in your preferences.

contact.question: How fast does support reply?
contact.answer: We handle requests Monday?Friday. Most tickets get a first reply within 1?2 business days.
